snippet.title: Final Splash : Official Trailer | PC
snippet.description:
🌊 We’re thrilled to reveal the official trailer of our very first game... Final Splash! 🦈💥

The ocean is collapsing under pollution, and sharks can’t stand watching their home disappear. So, they’ve made a bold choice: leave it all behind and turn their fate into pure chaos.

⚡ 3... 2... 1... The first to die wins!

Dive into a wild, fast-paced adventure where survival means losing the game.


Wishist it on Steam right now :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026500/Final_Splash/
